inputs.title: Kyutai Releases Voice of Reason: A Speech-Native Model that Solves Spoken Math with Reinforcement Learning
inputs.summary: Kyutai has released Voice of Reason, 2 open-weight speech-to-speech models built on GLM-4-Voice-9B. Supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning lift spoken GSM8K accuracy from 27.3% to 77.1%. There is no transcription step and no text LLM in the loop. Both checkpoints are on Hugging Face and run on a single H100. inputs.summary: OpenAI has released GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, 2 lower-cost models trained with methods similar to GPT-6 Astra. Sol costs $2/$10 and Luna $0.10/$0.50 per 1M tokens.
